question: Can a fixed native-channel connection edit help fresh executable coding when it acts on the whole prompt and generation,without knowing where the answer comparator occurs?
why_this_question: N19 establishes full current-state control but its response-derived prefix and all-correct baselines cannot establish a deployable coding improvement. N20 tests a fixed sparse hypothesis on those same cases. A separate utility assay needs fresh cases and an answer-independent edit.

candidate_source.groups: The already frozen selected64 and both random64 groups only. No nested16 substitution, new ranking, new coordinate, per-neuron strength or outcome-selected gain.
candidate_source.selection_limits: Matching refers to the saved discovery current-position RMS,donor-change RMS and outgoing norm. It does not establish global-position or fresh-task activity matching.

candidate_edits.primary: One prescribed factor2 applied to the selected native outgoing columns for the entire prompt and generation. No response-derived trigger, donor state or task-answer lookup.
candidate_edits.controls: Original parent;same-scope factor1 identity;factor2 on each fixed random group. Prescribed factor0 conditions may test loss separately if included prospectively. All retained conditions need a frozen final protocol before any fresh outcome.
candidate_edits.mathematics: At fixed native input,selected-column gain g changes raw MLP output y by (g-1)*sum(v_j*h_j). Gemma applies RMSNorm(y) before residual addition,so the resulting residual change is not this raw vector alone. Uniform positive scaling can mostly cancel when variance dominates epsilon.
candidate_edits.implementation_gate: A global activation hook and a stored-column assignment have equal ideal raw algebra but finite-precision equivalence is an empirical guard,not assumed. Pick one implementation prospectively;do not choose it using coding outcomes. Validate dense BF16 scope,identity,restoration and declared parameter-version increments on the actual checkpoint before utility interpretation. Never index packed NF4 as dense.
candidate_edits.no_fitting: No strength search,closed-form fitted coefficients,learned bridge,contrast vector application,optimizer or training of added neurons/layers. Measurement-based ranking remains a development choice.

fresh_evaluation_design.status: Design constraints only. No task prompts,answers or model responses created yet. Counts/caps/inferential thresholds are not a frozen GPU protocol.
fresh_evaluation_design.unit: Complete small Python functions with supplied interface specifications and independently implemented executable oracles. Distinguish algorithm families from repeated names or input variants.
candidate_families: signed integer quotient and remainder rules
fresh_evaluation_design.separation: New tasks must stay outside N20 generation/training assets and all old C01/final panels. No old answers are opened. Hidden oracle code/answers never enter model inputs or external APIs.
fresh_evaluation_design.selection: Freeze prompts,parsing,oracles,all variants and primary contrasts before model outputs. Retain every original coding case for gains and losses;do not select the original-error subset as the headline denominator.
fresh_evaluation_design.baseline_stops: A prospective baseline gate may stop if there is no room for improvement or if format/execution failures prevent a meaningful assay. Preserve all original outputs;do not rewrite the same cases and rerun them as confirmation.
fresh_evaluation_design.outcomes: Report intended function correctness,source/execution failures,caps,all gains/losses and independent retention. A functional score change is separate from a semantic neuron role and from sampling/output-format elicitation.
fresh_evaluation_design.statistics: Predeclare the primary selected-factor2 contrasts against the original and both random-factor2 controls. Treat task families as dependence clusters;do not treat nuisance replications as independent algorithms or report a winning dose. Small-sample claims must retain uncertainty and multiplicity.
fresh_evaluation_design.decoding: Identical frozen tokenizer/chat template,greedy parameters and caps for every arm. No sampling rerolls or answer-conditioned prefix. Final runtime and cap must fit one bounded free job;no current launch-ready count exists.

normalization_gate: N21H is a separately frozen host-only mathematical/scope probe using random-weight modules and constructed vectors. Its result cannot establish a pretrained function or explain an earlier scientific null.
relationship_to_N20: N20 is first. No new GPU job before its terminal status and guard audit or preserved failure. A failed N20 role screen remains failed;utility,if later tested,does not retroactively validate that role. Any implementation guard failure must be resolved before a utility claim.
construction_route: New neuron/layer construction remains conditional on a validated source-function hypothesis and equivalent-gain/random controls. Extra capacity or recombination alone is not a new capability.
resources: No money. Fresh permitted free quota and>=2h reserve required;one private job<=7200s and the original31October18:22:58UTC deadline. No browser-permission bypass.
release: Only reviewed generic methods,fixture code and aggregate progress may be public. Fresh raw tasks,answers,outputs,activations and unpublished paper stay private. Validated future compact edit recipes need exact parent/source/scope proofs;no full base copies.

cache_path_prediction.prediction: All candidate/control down-column edits follow the native K/V producers. On an identical fixed prompt,the first-prefill whole-cache fingerprint should remain exact while current logits may change. Verify this in the future actual-checkpoint scope gate.
cache_path_prediction.limit: Free generation can emit different tokens,which can change later cache entries through changed text. Do not claim entire edited generation has the same cache or that memory semantics are unchanged.
cache_path_prediction.efficiency: No speedup or reusable-decoder implementation is established;do not build a new caching engine in this sprint without evidence and a specific budgeted question.
